dedupe_keys.name: waterways ireland navigation and infrastructure layers

description: Waterways Ireland publishes a set of ArcGIS feature services for the inland waterways it manages. Navigation Routes gives route alignments for rivers, canals, lakes and connected navigation sections, classified by region, waterway, section, navigation status and management references. Waterway Infrastructure holds a public subset of its asset data, such as navigation aids, locks, bridges, moorings, service facilities and access points. Waterways Warnings and Notices gives location-specific navigation updates, safety advice, temporary restrictions and closures, and further layers cover marinas, shallow water zones, barge turning points, waterway facilities, routes and corridors, activity zones and navigation information. Coverage is the inland waterways in Ireland managed by Waterways Ireland, including branches and feeder channels. Access: free feature services on ArcGIS Online, updated in July 2026, provided for information and public reference; Waterways Ireland does not guarantee completeness or accuracy, and no open licence is named. Caveats: the asset layer is a curated public subset, and the notices change often. It supports inland waterway network topology, lock and bridge asset exposure, closure and disruption analysis, and navigation planning, and complements the EU inland fairway network graphs catalogued here.
